drhp.business: DCM Nouvelle manufactures and exports 100% cotton carded, combed, compact and two-ply yarns in counts ranging from Ne 12s/14s to 40s, sold through dealers and agents to manufacturers of towels, hosiery, garments, home textiles and industrial fabrics. Its premium brands FUTURO, PRIMERO, DINERO and CCY represent compact, combed, and carded & double yarns respectively, alongside a portfolio of Better Cotton (BCI) and sustainable yarns. Through its subsidiary DCM Nouvelle Specialty Chemicals Limited, the group also manufactures specialty amines (Benzylamine, Dibenzylamine) used in pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, rubber processing and industrial applications.

drhp.expansion: During FY 2025-26, DCM Nouvelle installed four new Two-for-One (TFO) Twisters (800 spindles) for high-value Combed Double Yarns and Compact Double Yarns, an Individual Spindle Monitoring System (suitable for RF LRJ9/SX machines) and a Carriage Tube Loader Assembly (4Q-5QDHQ1812, up to 1,200 spindles) at its Hisar spinning facility, and commissioned a 500 KW ground-mounted solar power plant to reduce dependence on conventional power. No new plant or greenfield project with a commissioning timeline was disclosed.

demand_drivers.title: Mdna (RHP)
demand_drivers.body:
- India's textile exports and the cotton yarn market are expected to grow structurally, supported by the 'China Plus One' sourcing diversification, PM MITRA Scheme, PLI Scheme for Textiles, cotton sector reforms and proposed free trade agreements including the India-EU FTA
- Growing consumer preference for sustainable textiles, value-added products and digital commerce platforms is expected to provide new avenues for product diversification and market expansion
- Company continued to improve capacity utilisation at its spinning operations and increase the share of value-added yarns, aiming to improve product realisations
- Volatility in cotton prices, foreign exchange fluctuations, geopolitical uncertainties and rising input costs are cited as demand/margin headwinds for the sector

capex_expansion.title: Expansion (RHP)
capex_expansion.body: During FY 2025-26, DCM Nouvelle installed four new Two-for-One (TFO) Twisters (800 spindles) for high-value Combed Double Yarns and Compact Double Yarns, an Individual Spindle Monitoring System (suitable for RF LRJ9/SX machines) and a Carriage Tube Loader Assembly (4Q-5QDHQ1812, up to 1,200 spindles) at its Hisar spinning facility, and commissioned a 500 KW ground-mounted solar power plant to reduce dependence on conventional power. No new plant or greenfield project with a commissioning timeline was disclosed.

moat.title: Strengths (RHP)
moat.body:
- brand: multiple premium yarn brands (FUTURO, PRIMERO, DINERO, CCY) built around specific yarn types — evidence: brands represent compact, combed, and carded & double yarns respectively, per the Directors' Report
- distribution: exports reach a broad international footprint — evidence: products exported to 16 countries across Asia, Europe, Africa and the Middle East, with exports contributing 40.24% of FY26 revenue

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- The sector is vulnerable to fluctuations in raw-material prices such as cotton, influenced by climate variability, trade policies and global oil prices, directly impacting input costs.
- The textile sector is deeply exposed to foreign exchange risk, especially in export-driven economies, where currency fluctuations can significantly affect revenue; the Company itself derives 40.24% of revenue from exports.
- Intense global competition, particularly from low-cost manufacturing countries/hubs, exerts continuous pressure on profit margins.
- Geopolitical tensions, evolving global trade dynamics, tariffs and export-import restrictions affect industry cost structures and market accessibility.
- Governments are tightening environmental and labour regulations, compelling investment in cleaner technologies and workplace conditions; non-compliance can result in fines, production halts or reputational damage.
- Supply chain disruptions and rising input costs present challenges to the industry alongside evolving customer preferences.
- The Company operates in a single reportable business segment (Textiles, cotton yarn), concentrating business risk in one product line.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Strengthening operational excellence and cost competitiveness
- Expanding the contribution of value-added and specialty products
- Enhancing customer engagement and delivering differentiated solutions
- Accelerating digitalisation and technology-driven transformation across operations
- Building resilient manufacturing capabilities and agile supply chains
- Expanding presence across domestic and international markets
- Diversification into specialty chemicals through subsidiary DCM Nouvelle Specialty Chemicals Limited to build complementary revenue streams
- Maintaining disciplined capital allocation, efficient working capital management, and liquidity preservation
